statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness
The symptoms are consistent with supraventricular tachycardia and sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease
The service is ordered to correlate intermittent symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias
The service is ordered to guide further management of conduction abnormalities
The diagnosis codes are I47.1, I25.10, and I49.5
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
